subject: [PATCH v2 1/4] mm: support promotion-only NUMA hinting scans

2026-09-11.patch_summary: This patch introduces support for promotion-only NUMA hinting scans in the Linux kernel. It adds a new flag MM_CP_PROT_NUMA_PROMO_ONLY to distinguish between placement and promotion-only scans, allowing the scanner to choose whether to promote pages or not. The change is made to the mm module, specifically in the functions change_prot_numa(), task_numa_work(), and vma_set_file(). The patch preserves existing behavior for certain fixes related to NUMA balancing and memory tiering systems.
